color.$description: Dark-mode semantic color roles — aliases onto the same primitive ramps as light mode. Light mode lives in color.light.tokens.json; mode-independent colors in color.fixed.tokens.json. primary/secondary/tertiary are PLACEHOLDERS aliasing the neutral ramp until a chromatic brand accent exists (the foundation primary/secondary 400 step diverges from neutral.400 — accepted, no new ramp invented).

primary.$description: PLACEHOLDER: aliases the neutral ramp — no chromatic brand accent yet. Re-point or de-alias when a brand hue exists.

secondary.$description: PLACEHOLDER: aliases the neutral ramp pending a chromatic brand accent.

tertiary.$description: PLACEHOLDER: aliases the neutral ramp pending a chromatic brand accent.
